cc:Work.dc:description: Source: tables/policies.csv. Condition: Time-25 three evidence variants; conditional replay. Model: llama3.1:8b, local. Budget: 14K/16K/18K/20K; at most one Full. Verification tokens: provider input plus output; replay has no fresh inference. Dagger marks incomplete L1 coverage; those cells are not successful L1-first comparisons. Strict bounds rely on the pinned Llama 3 chat/tokenizer protocol.
